hero.description: automex è un'azienda di software e IA enterprise con sede a Seattle, WA. Progettiamo e distribuiamo sistemi di automazione intelligenti, software su misura e prodotti basati sull'IA che liberano il tuo team dal lavoro ripetitivo.

story.title: Nati a Seattle. Costruiti per il mondo.
story.pullQuote: Abbiamo fondato automex perché gli ottimi strumenti di IA e automazione non dovrebbero essere un privilegio riservato alle Fortune 500.
story.body1: Nel 2020 siamo partiti da Seattle con un'unica convinzione: ogni azienda, non solo le più grandi, merita l'accesso ad automazione e IA di livello enterprise. Abbiamo iniziato risolvendo problemi operativi reali per le PMI e abbiamo rapidamente scoperto che l'esigenza andava ben oltre il Pacific Northwest.
story.body2: Oggi automex opera su due continenti, servendo clienti in 12 paesi. Il nostro team è distribuito tra Seattle e Kabul, unendo un'ingegneria di livello Silicon Valley con la determinazione e l'etica del lavoro di un team che sa esattamente cosa è in gioco.

mission.missionBody: Rendere l'automazione IA di livello enterprise accessibile a ogni azienda dalle startup in rapida crescita alle grandi imprese affermate affinché i loro team possano concentrarsi interamente sul lavoro che conta e sulle decisioni che fanno la differenza.
mission.visionBody: Un mondo in cui i processi aziendali ripetitivi e manuali siano completamente automatizzati. Dove le persone dedichino il proprio tempo a pensare, creare e guidare non a copiare e incollare, formattare o navigare tra dashboard. Stiamo costruendo l'infrastruttura che rende possibile questo mondo.

stats.title: La fiducia di team in tutto il mondo

values.title: Principi che guidano ogni decisione
values.description: Non sono poster appesi a un muro. Sono i filtri che applichiamo quando prendiamo decisioni sui prodotti, scegliamo i clienti e costruiamo sistemi che devono funzionare ancora tra cinque anni.
values.v1Body: Puntiamo allo strumento migliore disponibile IA, automazione o codice su misura non a quello più familiare. Ogni progetto è un'occasione per alzare l'asticella.
values.v2Body: Diciamo ciò che faremo e facciamo ciò che diciamo. Nessuna scatola nera, nessun ambito nascosto, nessuna sorpresa il giorno della fattura.
values.v3Body: Misuriamo il successo in ore risparmiate, entrate generate e problemi eliminati non in slide consegnate o ticket chiusi.
values.v4Body: Il tuo obiettivo aziendale è il nostro obiettivo. Lavoriamo al fianco del tuo team come co-pilota tecnico investito nel risultato, non come fornitore che consegna deliverable.
values.v5Body: Ogni riga di codice, ogni integrazione, ogni distribuzione è di livello produzione. Non consegniamo nulla che noi stessi non useremmo.
values.v6Body: Il nostro team si estende su continenti e fusi orari. Costruiamo prodotti che funzionano per ogni regione, lingua e cultura perché il mondo è il nostro mercato.

timeline.title: Cinque anni di crescita
timeline.description: Da una consulenza individuale a Seattle a un'azienda globale di IA e software con clienti su quattro continenti.
timeline.m1Body: Lanciata come boutique di consulenza software focalizzata sull'automazione e su applicazioni web su misura per le PMI del Pacific Northwest.
timeline.m2Body: Abbiamo consegnato i nostri primi progetti di automazione CRM e integrazione ERP enterprise, facendo risparmiare ai clienti migliaia di ore manuali all'anno.
timeline.m3Body: Espansione verso prodotti basati sull'IA: chatbot intelligenti, agenti di lead generation e pipeline di dati distribuiti in diversi settori.
timeline.m4Body: Aperte operazioni di ingegneria a Kabul, Afghanistan, estendendo la nostra presenza di servizio a clienti in Asia, Europa e Medio Oriente.
timeline.m5Body: Superati 50 clienti attivi. Agenti IA, piattaforme SaaS, app mobili e sistemi di automazione sono ora affidati a team su quattro continenti.
timeline.m6Body: Rilascio della nostra suite più ambiziosa: automazione IA end-to-end, infrastruttura di agenti multicanale e dashboard enterprise progettate per scalare.

team.title: Le persone dietro automex
team.description: Un team piccolo e senior con profonda competenza in IA, software enterprise e delivery di prodotti. Restiamo snelli di proposito questo ci mantiene lucidi e responsabili.
team.m1Bio: Da ingegnere a imprenditore. Miraj ha fondato automex per portare l'automazione IA di livello enterprise oltre la Silicon Valley. Guida la strategia di prodotto, le relazioni con i clienti e l'architettura tecnica in entrambi gli uffici.
team.m2Bio: Da ingegnere full-stack a dirigente tecnologico. Hakim ora supervisiona la strategia tecnica, l'innovazione e la cultura ingegneristica. Garantisce che ogni prodotto rilasciato da automex sia affidabile, sicuro e costruito per durare oltre le tendenze.
team.m3Bio: Abdullah è uno specialista di backend e infrastrutture con oltre 7 anni di esperienza nella creazione di microservizi ad alto throughput e sistemi in tempo reale. Guida il team di ingegneria nell'implementazione di soluzioni robuste e scalabili e promuove la qualità del codice e le prestazioni.

PrivacyPolicy.metaDescription: Learn how Automex collects, uses, and protects your personal information. Effective July 2025.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {company} ("Automex", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you visit {site}, use our platform, or engage our services (collectively, the "Services"). Please read this policy carefully. If you disagree with its terms, please discontinue use of the Services.

section1.intro: We collect information you provide directly, information collected automatically, and information from third parties.

1.title: 1.1 Information You Provide Directly
items: Account & contact data — name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, and password when you create an account or submit a contact form.
Billing & payment data — billing address and payment method details (processed by our PCI-DSS-compliant payment processors; we do not store full card numbers).
Communications — messages, emails, support tickets, and any content you send to us or upload to our platform.
Survey and feedback data — responses to questionnaires, testimonials, and product feedback.

2.title: 1.2 Information Collected Automatically
items: Usage data — pages visited, features used, clicks, search queries, timestamps, and session duration.
Device and log data — IP address, browser type and version, operating system, referral URL, and crash reports.
Cookies and tracking technologies — we use first-party and third-party cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies as described in Section 7 below.

3.title: 1.3 Information from Third Parties
items: OAuth providers — if you sign in with Google or another OAuth provider, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture from that provider.
Integration partners — when you connect third-party services (e.g., HubSpot, Slack, Asana) to Automex, we receive the data necessary to operate those integrations on your behalf.
Publicly available sources — business directories, LinkedIn, and similar sources for sales and marketing purposes.

section2.intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
items: Providing and operating the Services — to create and manage your account, process transactions, authenticate your identity, and deliver the features you request.
Improving and developing the Services — to analyze usage patterns, diagnose technical problems, conduct research, and build new features.
Communications — to send transactional messages (receipts, security alerts, account notices) and, with your consent, marketing emails. You may opt out of marketing at any time.
Customer support — to respond to inquiries, resolve disputes, and troubleshoot issues.
Legal compliance and safety — to comply with applicable laws and regulations, enforce our terms, and protect the rights, property, and safety of Automex, our users, and the public.
Fraud prevention and security — to detect, investigate, and prevent fraudulent transactions, abuse, and other illegal activity.
section2.legalBasis: We process your personal data under the following legal bases (where applicable under US privacy law and international standards): contract performance (fulfilling our agreement with you), legitimate interests (improving and securing the Services), legal obligation, and consent (for optional marketing communications).

section3.intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We share it only as described below.
items: Service providers — third-party vendors who process data on our behalf (cloud hosting, payment processing, email delivery, analytics, customer support tooling). These vendors are contractually bound to protect your data and may not use it for their own purposes.

Integration partners — when you explicitly connect a third-party tool to Automex, we share the data necessary to operate that integration. Your use of third-party services is governed by their own privacy policies.

Business transfers — in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you via email or prominent notice on our site if such a transfer occurs.
Legal requirements — we may disclose your data if required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or to enforce our agreements or protect our rights.
With your consent — we may share your data for any other purpose with your explicit consent.

section4.intro: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Services. Specifically:
items: Account data — is retained for the life of your account and up to 3 years after closure for dispute resolution, fraud prevention, and compliance with our legal obligations.
Financial and transactional records — are retained for a minimum of 7 years as required by US tax and accounting regulations.
Marketing data — is retained until you opt out or withdraw consent, after which we suppress your contact from future campaigns but may retain a record of the opt-out.
Server and security logs — are retained for up to 90 days and used solely for security and debugging.
section4.disposal: When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.

items: TLS 1.2+ encryption in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest.
Role-based access controls limiting employee access to personal data.
Regular security assessments and penetration testing.
Multi-factor authentication requirements for internal systems that process personal data.
section5.disclaimer: No method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security; however, we are committed to promptly notifying affected users in the event of a data breach as required by applicable law, including Washington State's Security Breach Notification Act (RCW 19.255).

section6.intro: Depending on where you reside, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.

1.title: 6.1 Washington State Residents
1.content: Washington's My Health MY Data Act (MHMD) and the Washington Privacy Act (WPA) provide residents with rights to access, correct, and delete certain personal data. Automex honors these rights for all users regardless of state.

2.title: 6.2 California Residents (CCPA / CPRA)
2.content: California residents have the right to: (a) know what personal information we collect and how we use and share it; (b) delete personal information we hold about you; (c) opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information (we do not sell personal information); (d) correct inaccurate personal information; and (e) limit use of sensitive personal information. To exercise these rights, contact us at {email}. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

3.title: 6.3 All Users
items: Access & portability — you may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you in a structured, machine-readable format.
Correction — you may update or correct inaccurate data through your account settings or by contacting us.
Deletion — you may request deletion of your personal data. We will fulfill your request unless retention is required by law or for legitimate business purposes (e.g., fraud prevention).
Opt out of marketing — you may unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by clicking 'Unsubscribe' in any email or contacting us directly.
Account closure — you may close your account at any time through the account settings page.
3.requestProcess: To submit a rights request, email {email} with the subject line "Privacy Rights Request." We will respond within 45 days (with up to a 45-day extension where reasonably necessary).

section7.intro: We use the following types of cookies and similar technologies:
items: Strictly necessary cookies — required for the Services to function (session management, authentication, security). These cannot be disabled.
Analytics cookies — help us understand how users interact with the Services (e.g., page views, session duration). We use tools such as Google Analytics with IP anonymization enabled.
Preference cookies — remember your settings (e.g., language, theme) so you do not have to set them on every visit.
Marketing cookies — used with your consent to deliver relevant advertisements. We do not use third-party ad networks without your explicit consent.
section7.control: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Services. We honor browser-based 'Do Not Track' (DNT) signals to the extent technically feasible.

section8.content: The Services may contain links to third-party websites, integrations, or services that are not operated by Automex. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of any third party. We encourage you to review the privacy policy of every site or service you visit.

section9.content: The Services are not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at {email}. If we discover we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will promptly delete it in accordance with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).

section10.content: Automex is headquartered in the United States. If you access the Services from outside the United States, your information will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States or other countries where our service providers operate. By using the Services, you consent to this transfer. We take steps to ensure that your data receives an adequate level of protection wherever it is processed.

section11.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will notify you by:
items: Posting the updated policy on this page with a revised 'Effective date' at the top.
Sending an email notice to the address associated with your account at least 30 days before the changes take effect.
section11.acceptance: Your continued use of the Services after the effective date constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy. If you do not agree to the changes, you must stop using the Services and may request account deletion.

section12.intro: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
section12.commitment: We are committed to resolving complaints about your privacy and our collection or use of your personal information. If you have an unresolved privacy or data use concern that we have not addressed satisfactorily, please contact us at the email above.
